home.petBody: A preform is an intermediate product that is manufactured from polyethylene terephthalate (PET). Primarily, a PET preform is a test tube-shaped article of synthetic plastic that vary in weight, colour, neck finish and shape. It is made by a process called injection moulding, using a plastic called PET in different market segments. The PET material is formed to a shape which is moulded to a specific shape. Furthermore, it is particularly designed to meet the needs of customers. Preform weight often depends on the bottom and the container’s desired volume or shape. As of now, there are many PET Preform Manufacturers in the world, who take account of all the factors that require attention while producing your customised product. about.title: About Basil-Plast
paragraphs: Basil-Plast is a PET plastic manufacturer headquartered in Chisinau-Moldova.
Basil-Plast laid its foundation in 2019 in Chisinau-Moldova, as a manufacturer, exporter and supplier of PET performs
Basil-Plast is an independent family business, firmly geared towards innovation, with a global performance based around 3 inseparables principles: Economic, Social and Environmental responsibility.
Since the beginning We have taken quality as the backbone of the company. Due to our faith and belief in Quality,
Basil-Plast today supplies to various national corporations who go through stringent quality tests only to come to the conclusion that; if a superior product is desired Basil plast is the way to go.

With multiple manufacturing locations and corporate offices, this group has learnt that the only way to be successful/ profitable in business is via customer satisfaction and mutual benefit. Basil-Plast continues to grow with regular investments and constantly moves ahead in the true spirit of enterprise and excellence.
We are proud to offer flexible order quantities from as low as 10,000 parts to high volume orders in the millions

We also have   We also have the capability to manufacture preforms in a range of colors and specialty additives. We offer preforms made of PET as well as R-PET and PLA biopolymers, as a part of our effort to reduce the carbon footprint.
We're constantly updated on new trends, future innovations and European standards so that we anticipate our customer's needs better.
We also invest in regular training techniques to improve our competitiveness, abilities and responsiveness.

Our main value added has been by providing quality, mass-manufactured factory priced products and exporting them. Clients usually come to us because of our low MOQ, extra services such as warehousing, quality guarantees and many more
We believe in a high touch customer service and clear sales process, and you can be sure that you will be served well by our enthusiastic team!
